title: Multilingual Content Moderation: A Case Study on Reddit
reasoning: The paper benchmarks content moderation on Reddit, which involves identifying violations of moral and ethical community standards (e.g., civility, hate speech). It specifically includes religious subreddits (r/judaism, r/islam, r/christianity) in its benchmark evaluation and uses 'Hate Speech-Religion' (HS-Religion) as a distinct classification category in its analysis.
